author: SagBags
body:
User: MincraftAndChill

Its been 11 months since my last appeal and my ban. I apologize again for my actions and wish to be unbanned. Hacking on Avicus was one of the worse things I have done and I really regret it. Since that date I have never hacked on a server and I never will. I deeply regret my decision and hope that enough time has gone by to unban me. I really used to enjoy Avicus and I hope I will appealed soon. Again, I am sorry. 

- MincraftAndChill
